nip07.found: We found an extension — click Connect and it will ask for access to your public key.
nip07.missing: No extension found. Install Alby, nos2x or Keys.Band and reload the page — then connecting works here.

bunker.label: bunker link
bunker.hint: The private key stays in the vault (Sovereign / nsec.app / Amber); the page only sees the public key and signatures. Locally we keep the client key — never your root key.

nsec.label: nsec (dev only)
nsec.hint: The key is stored in `sessionStorage` — it disappears when you close the tab. A production instance does not offer this option at all.

errors.noSigner: you are not signed in — nobody can create the signature
errors.noSignerNip98: you are not signed in — nobody can sign the NIP-98 auth
errors.nip07BadPubkey: NIP-07 getPublicKey returned an invalid pubkey: {{raw}}…
errors.nip07IdMismatch: NIP-07 signEvent returned id {{returned}}…, but we expected {{expected}}… (different created_at/tags?)
errors.nip07NoSignature: NIP-07 signEvent did not return a 128-hex signature
errors.nip07OtherPubkey: NIP-07 signEvent returned a different pubkey than getPublicKey promised
errors.nip07Verify: the NIP-07 signature failed verifyEvent (signature or id does not match the content)
errors.eventIdMismatch: internal error: the event id does not match the content hash
errors.bunkerUriBad: invalid bunker link: {{uri}}… (we expect bunker://… or nip05@domain)
errors.bunkerBadPubkey: the bunker returned an invalid pubkey: {{raw}}…
errors.bunkerVerify: the bunker signature failed verifyEvent (id or signature does not match the content)
errors.bunkerSessionKey: the stored bunker session has no valid client key
errors.extensionMissing: no nostr extension is installed — try Alby, nos2x or Keys.Band and reload the page
errors.nsecDisabled: pasting an nsec is disabled on this instance (VITE_ALLOW_NSEC=true is missing)
errors.nsecWrongType: we expected an nsec1… key or a 64-hex key, we got {{type}}
